title: Exchange week
summary: An exchange student from Ireland spends a week in Málaga, and both families learn more than they expected.
paragraphs: When Aoife arrived from Dublin for the school exchange, Carmen was nervous. She had studied English for eight years, but she had never spoken it for a whole week. What would they talk about? What if Aoife didn't like Spanish food? What if they had nothing in {{common}}?

The first evening was {{awkward}}. Carmen's mother cooked a big dinner at ten o'clock at night, and Aoife, who usually ate at six, nearly fell asleep at the table. Carmen's little brother asked her questions about leprechauns, and Aoife politely explained that she had never met one.

Things got better on the second day. At school, Aoife sat in on a maths lesson and was surprised that the students called their teacher by her first name. Carmen was surprised that this surprised her. They spent the afternoon at the beach, and Aoife swam in the sea in October, which the local people thought was crazy and Aoife thought was warm.

By the middle of the week they had found many things in common: the same terrible taste in music, a love of mystery films and a habit of laughing at the wrong moment. Carmen's English became faster and more natural. She stopped translating every sentence in her head and just spoke.

On the last night, Aoife cooked for the family: a simple Irish {{stew}}. She made it at six o'clock, and everybody was hungry and confused. They ate it anyway, and it was delicious. In March, Carmen will fly to Dublin. She has already started to {{practise}} eating dinner early, and she has bought a very warm coat.

common.meaning: shared by two or more people (have something in common)

practise.meaning: do something many times so you get better at it

stew.meaning: meat and vegetables cooked slowly in liquid

questions.question: Why was Carmen nervous before Aoife arrived?
options: She didn't want an exchange student.
She worried they would have nothing to talk about.
questions.explanation: She worried about what they would talk about and whether they had anything in common.

questions.question: What surprised Aoife at school?
options: Students used the teacher's first name.
questions.explanation: She was surprised that the students called their teacher by her first name.

questions.question: How did Carmen's English change during the week?
options: She stopped translating in her head and spoke more naturally.
She only used English at school.
questions.explanation: Her English became faster and more natural, and she stopped translating every sentence.

questions.question: Why was the family "hungry and confused" on the last night?
options: Dinner was at six o'clock, much earlier than usual.
Aoife cooked a dish they didn't know.
questions.explanation: Aoife made the stew at six o'clock, much earlier than the family usually ate.
